title: Peaceful Life
description: Locks the world difficulty to Peaceful for cozy modpacks and or simple Peaceful worlds.
body:
PeacefulLife is a lightweight Fabric mod that permanently locks your Minecraft world to Peaceful difficulty, designed specifically for cozy, relaxed, and simulation-focused modpacks.

The mod automatically enforces Peaceful:

- When the world or server starts

- Continuously during gameplay to prevent changes

This makes it ideal for:

- Cozy and cottagecore modpacks

- Creative-focused survival worlds

- Builder and roleplay servers

- Accessibility-friendly setups

- Modpacks where combat is not the focus

PeacefulLife works in singleplayer (integrated server) and multiplayer servers, requires no configuration, and has virtually zero performance impact.

🧡 Created by LizzyWorks

PeacefulLife is intentionally simple — it does one thing, and does it reliably.
